# sed

Transform a text stream with editing commands through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/sed 's/old/new/g' input.txt

moonx cli/sed -n '2,4p' input.txt

moonx cli/sed -E 's/([0-9]+)/[\1]/g' input.txt
```

Read a script operand, -e expressions or -f files. Print pattern space by default; -n enables explicit-print mode.

## Notes

Compatible with the MoonBit 2026-11-17 toolchain.

- Supports the documented BRE/ERE, hold-space, branch and multiline profile. In-place -i editing and the complete GNU script grammar are unsupported.
- Memory can grow with script-controlled pattern and hold spaces.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
